skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the emergence and development of the Roman state and legal system from its inception to its end.
Analyze the regulations concerning property rights and the system of property rights in Roman law.
Analyze the regulations concerning debt rights and the system of debt rights in Roman law.
Analyze the regulations concerning marriage and family law in Roman law.
Analyze the regulations concerning inheritance law in Roman law.
Apply legal English skills for work purposes.
Use computers with internet connectivity to search for information, legal texts, and check the validity of legal texts for work purposes.
Analyze and synthesize information about legal situations.
Have the ability to self-study, accumulate knowledge and experience to improve professional expertise.
